issues.detail: The Greek 'υπεριδων' (hyperidōn) is a compound word meaning 'over-years' or 'ages/eons'. The Vietnamese translation 'đã bỏ qua' (has passed/skipped/ignored) misinterprets the temporal scope. The Greek structure 'τους μεν ουν χρονους... τα νυν' implies a contrast between the ages of ignorance and the current command. 'Bỏ qua' suggests a deliberate action of skipping, whereas the Greek describes a transition of time.
